meta.notes: One shot per clause (56 clauses, 204.9 s). Timing is the word-level transcript as delivered; no voiceover audio file was supplied. Transcript tokenisation artifacts ('co -worker', 'U .S.', '1 ,300') are kept in the narration exactly as delivered. Clause C031/C032 splits the sentence at 'suicide.' (the 1.0 s dramatic pause sits in C032) and C051/C052 splits '98 | years': both kept from the splitter and flagged for review.

assumptions: The tetraethyl lead production room, workers' overalls, tally board and caged bulbs are plausible 1920s industrial choices, not from the script.
The 'House of Butterflies' co-worker is shown as an old man at the Deepwater plant around 1950; the script gives only 'a quarter century later' and 'about 25 years after the deaths'.
Midgley's lab, GM reports office, filling station, Miami beach, Frigidaire lab, lecture hall, bedroom and coroner's office are plausible period settings invented for staging.
Hotel, deck chairs, bathers, waiter and brass band at Miami are invented to show a holiday; the script only says he took a vacation to recover.
The warning letter, calendar flips and ledgers are invented staging for 'warned as early as 1922', 'Counts of the dead differ' and dates; the script gives no such props.

Stretcher bearers, a woman at the gate and a plant manager (Dayton), the eight caps in the Deepwater locker room, the nurse and doctor at the Bayway ward are invented illustration of deaths; no gore is shown.
'LOONY GAS' chalked on a barrel and the SHUT notice are invented staging for 'called the additive loony gas' and 'ordered the plant shut'.
The press room details (grey suit, photographer, bottle on a side table, wall sign) are invented staging of Midgley holding the bottle under his nose.
The 1 in 1,300 vat with a single drop is a staging metaphor for the claim; the SAFE stamp is invented.
The two-gas flame and canary test at Frigidaire is an invented illustration of 'neither toxic nor flammable' (canaries were a common period toxicity test, not stated in the script).
Midgley's death scene shows only the housekeeper, the empty rope hoist and sling; no body is depicted. The hoist, sling and pulley wheel are assumed from 'ropes and pulleys he had built'.
The coroner stamp SUICIDE and the ACCIDENT headline stage 'a coroner ruled it a suicide / many accounts call it an accident'; the newspaper boy is invented.

The 1987 treaty hall with delegates signing, the wall map with an ozone patch, the museum timeline hall with a balance scale and the 2021 modern station are metaphors/illustrations for narration lines about CFC restriction, the historian's quote and 'no driver on Earth'.
The Algeria depot (tanks, hut, gauge board, tanker) is invented from 'the last stockpile, in Algeria'.
Needleman's long coat, black bag and the three older men in the shack are invented staging; the script says he asked about older men sitting apart, moving slowly with distant, empty voices.
Pale paper-white flecks (motif M1) stand for the insects the men saw; they return at the end as the payoff. Invented visual device.
Overlay text numbers/dates are digits from the narration; 'ethyl' and names are repeated as on-screen text for fact anchoring.
